product: FloodWatch South India public water observations
coverage_note: Only stations/resources exposed by the registered public data pages are included. This is not every river or dam. Per-station source timestamps and source URLs must be checked.

observation_semantics.river_level: Source-reported river water level; not necessarily a height above sea level and not a flood threshold unless a station-specific datum and official threshold are provided.
observation_semantics.reservoir_level: Source-reported reservoir water level; may not be comparable between reservoirs without their datum and full-reservoir-level metadata.
observation_semantics.reservoir_discharge: Release/outflow discharge, not reservoir level or storage.
observation_semantics.river_discharge: River flow measurement when a verified source provides it; not the same quantity as water level.
